payload.title: Wedding Destinations in August for Summer or Winter Weddings
payload.excerpt: For an August wedding abroad, choose the hemisphere before the venue. Europe is at the height of its summer, with long evenings and its busiest season, while Fiji, Mauritius and New Zealand are in their cooler months and Bali sits outside its usual wet season.
key_takeaways: The ten places are the Greek islands, Lake Como, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera, Portugal and Switzerland in Europe's high summer, and Bali, Fiji, New Zealand and Mauritius south of the equator.
On the Greek islands and the Riviera, August rain is slight on paper, so shade and ceremony timing matter more than a wet-weather plan.
15 August is a public holiday in Italy, so ask every Italian venue and supplier how they work on and around that date.
In Fiji and New Zealand, August 2026 weather differed sharply from coast to coast and region to region, so ask every venue for a covered or indoor option.

faq.q: Is August a good month to have a destination wedding?
faq.a: Yes, if you match the destination to the season: high summer in Europe, the cooler months in Fiji, Mauritius and New Zealand.

faq.q: Where is warm but not too hot for a wedding in August?
faq.a: Look south. In the 1971 to 2000 normals from Mauritius Meteorological Services, Port Louis has an August mean daily maximum of 26.8°C, and the Fiji Meteorological Service described August 2026 as a winter month in the dry season. Both sources are linked in the entries above.

faq.q: Where can you get married in Europe in August?
faq.a: The Greek islands, Lake Como, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera, Portugal and Switzerland all work, each with its own trade-off. Heat is the common thread.

faq.q: Is August peak season for weddings in Greece and Italy?
faq.a: Plan as though it is. August falls in high summer in both countries, and 15 August is a public holiday in Italy, so ask venues early about availability that week and how they staff it.

faq.q: Can Australians marry legally in these August destinations?
faq.a: It depends on the country, because legal requirements differ. Read the legal and symbolic ceremony guides linked above before you choose a destination.
